subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly Manila – Guangzhou – Changsha and head to Zhangjiajie, home of the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park). You get a two-hour skiing experience at Qixing Mountain, then see Avatar Hallelujah Mountain, No.1 Bridge and the Golden Whip Stream. Stays are in 5-star hotels with an English-speaking guide and private coach. This is a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 16–21 2027 to Feb 27–Mar 4 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Qixing Mountain: A Zhangjiajie scenic area with a battery car, a 1520 Platform and a glass skywalk, also home to a ski resort.
placeDesc.1520 Platform: A viewing platform in the Qixing Mountain scenic area, visited by battery car.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie Avatar scenic area: The sandstone-pillar landscape of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, associated with the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Elevator: A glass outdoor elevator built into a cliff face, used on this tour to go up or down the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Tianzishan: A mountain area in Zhangjiajie reached by cable car, an alternative way up and down the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge feature in the Zhangjiajie Avatar scenic area, visited on the walk.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The floating-mountain-style sandstone peak in Zhangjiajie that inspired scenes in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic stream valley in Zhangjiajie, walked along on the Avatar scenic area day.
placeDesc.Water Around Four Gates: A scenic spot in the Golden Whip Stream area of Zhangjiajie, visited on the same walk.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum in Zhangjiajie showing paintings made with local sandstone.
placeDesc.72-floor Stilt Tower: A stilt-style tower in Zhangjiajie, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A famous Zhangjiajie mountain with cable car, glass skywalk and Tianmen Cave; optional tour USD 85 per person.
placeDesc.Huanglong Cave: A large karst cave near Zhangjiajie with an underground river, visited with a boat cruise on the optional tour.
